reasoning_traces.think:
The STG-DB Net addresses core challenges in athlete pose estimation through a tri-layered architecture. The first layer, STGCN-IS, applies graph convolutional networks enhanced with bounding box constraints and skeletal clustering to isolate individual poses in multi-person scenes. This resolves aliasing issues where joint features from different athletes overlap. The second layer, DSTformer, employs a dual-branch attention mechanism combining spatial attention sensitive to occlusions with temporal windows that adapt to motion dynamics. This ensures robustness against high-speed motion and partial visibility. The third layer refines these estimates to improve localization accuracy. These modules collectively enable precise pose estimation in complex sports environments where traditional methods fail due to motion blur, occlusion, and multi-person confusion. The ablation study confirms each component contributes significantly to overall performance. The mathematical foundation lies in spatio-temporal graph convolutions and attention-based feature extraction, enabling scalable and modular design for real-time applications.
